nodes.title: Basic Movement
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student walks, runs, and stops with control, changes speed and direction on cue, and moves safely in shared space.

items: Walks and runs with control and stops safely on signal
Changes speed and direction on cue
Moves safely in shared space without collisions

nodes.title: Body Awareness
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student identifies body parts while moving, travels at high, middle, and low levels, and mirrors a simple movement sequence.

items: Identifies and uses named body parts while moving
Travels at high, middle, and low levels on cue
Mirrors a simple 3-move sequence shown by a partner

nodes.title: Coordination
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student performs cross-lateral movements, repeats a three-step movement pattern, and keeps a steady beat with claps or steps.

items: Performs cross-crawl / cross-lateral marching smoothly
Repeats a 3-step movement pattern after one demonstration
Keeps a steady beat with claps or steps to music

nodes.title: Locomotor Skills
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student hops on each foot, skips smoothly, gallops with either foot leading, and slides in both directions with mature form.

items: Hops 5 times on each foot without losing balance
Skips smoothly with alternating step-hop pattern
Gallops with either foot leading
Slides sideways in both directions

nodes.title: Jumping & Landing
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student takes off and lands on two feet, lands quietly with bent knees, and jumps for both distance and height.

items: Takes off and lands on two feet
Lands quietly with knees bent (soft landing)
Jumps for distance and for height with arm swing

nodes.title: Overhand Throw
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student throws overhand with side orientation, opposite-foot step, hip-shoulder rotation, and follow-through toward the target.

items: Turns side to target and steps with opposite foot
Rotates hips then shoulders during the throw
Follows through across the body toward the target

nodes.title: Catching
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student tracks the ball with the eyes, catches with hands only (no trapping), and adjusts position for high and low throws.

items: Tracks the ball with eyes all the way into the hands
Catches with hands only, without trapping against the body
Moves feet to adjust for high and low throws

nodes.title: Kicking
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student plants the non-kicking foot beside the ball, contacts with the laces, and kicks a moving ball with control.

items: Plants non-kicking foot beside the ball
Contacts the ball with laces, not toes
Kicks a slowly moving ball with control

nodes.title: Underhand Roll & Toss
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student uses a pendulum arm swing with opposite-foot step and releases smoothly to hit a target from 3 meters.

items: Uses pendulum arm swing with opposite-foot step
Releases smoothly at knee level
Hits a target from 3 meters on most attempts

nodes.title: Hand Dribbling
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student dribbles with finger pads at waist height, continues while walking, and can switch hands without stopping.

items: Dribbles with finger pads (not slapping) at waist height
Keeps the dribble going while walking
Switches hands without stopping the dribble

nodes.title: Striking with Implement
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student strikes from a sideways stance with a level swing, making contact off a tee and with a gently tossed ball.

items: Stands sideways to the target with bat/paddle back
Swings level and makes contact off a tee
Makes contact with a gently tossed ball

nodes.title: Static & Dynamic Balance
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student balances on one foot for 15 seconds per side, walks a line or beam forward and backward, and holds three body shapes for 5 seconds each.

items: Balances on one foot 15 seconds on each side
Walks a line or low beam forward and backward
Holds 3 different balance shapes for 5 seconds each

nodes.title: Endurance Run (PACER)
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student completes the PACER shuttle-run test reaching the grade-band lap benchmark, with results recorded over time.

nodes.title: Mile Run
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student completes a timed one-mile run at or under the grade-band benchmark time, with pacing recorded over the year.

nodes.title: Push-Ups
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student performs consecutive full-form push-ups (90-degree elbow bend) meeting the grade-band benchmark count.

nodes.title: Curl-Ups
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student performs consecutive controlled curl-ups meeting the grade-band benchmark count.

nodes.title: Plank Hold
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student holds a straight-body forearm plank for the grade-band benchmark time.

nodes.title: Sit-and-Reach
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student reaches the grade-band benchmark distance on the sit-and-reach flexibility test on both sides.

nodes.title: Shuttle Run
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student completes the 4x10-meter shuttle run at or under the grade-band benchmark time, demonstrating agility and quick direction change.

nodes.title: Standing Long Jump
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student jumps the grade-band benchmark distance from a standing two-foot take-off with a controlled landing.

nodes.title: Jump Rope Endurance
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student jumps rope consecutively without a miss, meeting the grade-band benchmark count.

nodes.title: Advanced Conditioning
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student reaches the exceeds level in at least three fitness measures on verified assessments in the same season.

nodes.title: Basketball Skills
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student demonstrates game-ready dribbling, passing and catching, shooting form, and defensive footwork, scored on a teacher rubric.

criteria: Passing and catching on the move

nodes.title: Soccer Skills
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student demonstrates game-ready dribbling, passing accuracy, receiving and first touch, and shooting, scored on a teacher rubric.

nodes.title: Volleyball Skills
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student demonstrates the forearm pass, overhead set, serve, and court movement, scored on a teacher rubric.

nodes.title: Throwing & Fielding Games
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student demonstrates throwing accuracy, fielding of grounders and flies, base running and game sense, and batting or striking, scored on a teacher rubric.

nodes.title: Racket & Net Sports
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student demonstrates ready position and footwork, forehand, backhand, and serving or sustained rally, scored on a teacher rubric.

nodes.title: Track & Field Events
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student demonstrates sprint form, distance pacing, one jumping event, and one throwing event with sound technique, scored on a teacher rubric.

nodes.title: Team Play
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student communicates with teammates, maintains positioning and spacing, supports the player with the ball, and fulfills a role within a team strategy.

criteria: Positioning and spacing without the ball
Fulfills assigned role within team strategy

nodes.title: Individual Sports
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student demonstrates consistent technique, self-pacing and strategy, rules and etiquette, and measurable improvement over a season in a chosen individual sport.

criteria: Knows and follows rules and etiquette

nodes.title: Team Sports
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student applies sport skills in live games, makes sound tactical decisions, works with teammates under pressure, and shows sportsmanship in competition.

criteria: Applies skills in live game situations

nodes.title: Outdoor Skills
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student manages personal gear, navigates using a map and landmarks, and applies leave-no-trace and weather-safety practices outdoors.

items: Packs, carries, and keeps track of personal gear
Navigates a simple route using a map and landmarks
Applies leave-no-trace principles
Explains and follows weather and terrain safety rules

nodes.title: Competitive Performance
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student prepares for competition, executes under pressure, maintains composure and resilience, and reflects on performance afterward.

nodes.title: Safety & Warm-Up Basics
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student explains why we warm up and cool down, identifies safe practice space and equipment rules, and passes the concept quiz at 80 percent.

nodes.title: Components of Fitness
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student names and distinguishes cardiovascular endurance, muscular strength, muscular endurance, and flexibility, and matches activities to each component.

nodes.title: Rules of Major Sports
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student answers rules questions for basketball, soccer, volleyball, and baseball or kickball, including scoring, boundaries, and common violations.

nodes.title: Sportsmanship & Fair Play
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student identifies fair and unfair behavior in game scenarios, wins and loses graciously, and explains why rules keep games fair and fun.

nodes.title: Hydration & Recovery
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student explains when and how much to drink around exercise, recognizes signs of dehydration and overheating, and describes why sleep and rest days matter.

nodes.title: Body Systems & Exercise
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student explains how the heart, lungs, and muscles respond to exercise, including heart rate, breathing rate, and how muscles grow stronger.

nodes.title: Health & Nutrition
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student identifies food groups and balanced meals, explains how nutrition fuels activity, and evaluates everyday food choices.

nodes.title: Injury Prevention
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student explains how to prevent common activity injuries, applies RICE for minor injuries, and recognizes when to stop and get adult help.

nodes.title: Game Strategy
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student explains offensive and defensive concepts such as creating space, defending space, and transitions, and chooses sound tactics in game scenarios.

nodes.title: Fitness Routines
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student sequences a warm-up, main activity, and cool-down, and explains what each phase does for the body.

nodes.title: Performance Training
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student applies the FITT principle and progressive overload to design training that improves a chosen fitness component safely.

nodes.title: Fitness Goal Setting
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student writes SMART fitness goals, tracks progress against a baseline, and adjusts goals based on results.

nodes.title: Personal Fitness Planning
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student passes the planning quiz and submits a personal fitness plan with SMART goals, a weekly schedule covering all fitness components, and a reflection, approved by the teacher.

criteria: Weekly schedule covers all fitness components
Plan matches the student's baseline data

nodes.title: Daily Activity Log
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student logs at least 30 minutes of physical activity on 20 different days, building a consistent movement habit.

nodes.title: Weekly Workout Habit
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student completes and logs three structured workouts per week for four weeks (12 sessions).

nodes.title: Stretching Routine
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student completes and logs ten stretching or mobility sessions of at least 10 minutes.

nodes.title: Physical Mastery
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student has earned Advanced Conditioning, an approved Personal Fitness Plan, and mastery of at least one sport rubric — the capstone of the Physical path.

merges.note: Motor Skills was an umbrella; split into observable fundamental motor skills (SHAPE-style locomotor + object control).
Agility & Balance split into an observable balance checklist and a measurable shuttle-run agility metric.
Endurance Basics split into the PACER endurance metric and jump-rope endurance.
Strength Development split into measurable push-up, curl-up, and plank tests.
Sport Fundamentals split into per-sport skill rubrics.
